title: Settings
subtitle: Make DocuRebuild yours. Everything is stored locally.

appearance.themeDescription: Choose light, dark, or follow your system setting.
appearance.accentDescription: Used for primary actions, selections, and highlights.
appearance.radiusDescription: Adjust how rounded panels and controls feel.
appearance.blurDescription: Transparency and blur on panels and dialogs.
appearance.densityDescription: Controls the height of toolbars and form fields.
appearance.fontSizeDescription: Only the application interface changes. Documents keep their own typography.
appearance.motionDescription: Reduce motion for comfort or accessibility.

language.title: Application language
language.description: Only the interface language changes. Your documents and OCR content are never translated.
language.burmeseNote: Burmese uses Unicode. Zawgyi text is preserved exactly as imported and is never converted automatically.

editor.description: Used for the document editor and future exports. Interface typography stays independent.
editor.preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. မြန်မာစာ စမ်းသပ်ချက်။

export.title: PDF layout
export.description: Choose the page size and margin for exported PDF files. The file is still created on this device.
export.pageSizeDescription: A4 is the default. Choose Letter for documents that use US paper.
export.marginDescription: Narrow fits more text on a page; wide leaves more white space.
export.note: These settings apply to PDF export only. Markdown, plain text and Word files keep their current format.

ocr.title: Local OCR engine
ocr.description: Tesseract extracts text on this device. Page images are never uploaded to an OCR service.
ocr.missingBurmese: Burmese (mya) language data is not installed. Install it before running Burmese OCR.
ocr.setupDescription: Install Tesseract and add the eng and mya traineddata files to its tessdata folder. If Tesseract is not on PATH, set DOCUREBUILD_TESSERACT_CMD to the executable.
ocr.privacy: OCR jobs run in a bounded local worker. Nothing is sent to a remote service, and no paid API is used.

unavailableReasons.not_found: Tesseract could not be found on this device.
unavailableReasons.not_executable: The configured Tesseract command cannot be run.
unavailableReasons.no_languages: Tesseract is installed, but no language data is available.
unavailableReasons.error: The OCR engine could not be checked.

ai.title: Local AI assistance
ai.description: Connect a local inference server to propose OCR text corrections. AI output is always a proposal until you review it.
ai.providerDescription: Both options expect a server running on this device or your own network.
ai.baseUrlDescription: Leave empty to use the provider default. The URL is only contacted when you test the connection or request a cleanup.
ai.allowRemoteDescription: Localhost and loopback addresses work without this. Any other host or IP requires explicit consent before text is sent.
ai.allowRemoteLabel: Allow sending OCR text to a non-loopback server I control
ai.costClassDescription: How this server is billed. Paid profiles ask for confirmation before every AI action; connection tests never need it.
ai.costClassHintLocal: Runs on this device. No provider charge.
ai.costClassHintFree: A remote free tier. Its limits and availability are set by the provider and can change.
ai.costClassHintPaid: Every AI action asks for approval before anything is sent.
ai.costClassRemoteHint: This URL is not on this device. It is saved as paid unless you verify a free tier.
ai.modelDescription: Used for OCR text cleanup. Type a model name or test the connection to discover installed models.
ai.textDescription: Used for OCR text cleanup. Leave the model empty to keep text AI disabled.
ai.visionModelDescription: Used only when you ask AI to propose figure, table or equation regions or transcribe an equation crop. The model must exist on the image analysis server below.
ai.visionModelEnabled: Region proposals and equation transcription are enabled. Each request is counted in the usage limit.
ai.visionModelDisabled: Leave empty to keep image AI disabled.
ai.apiKeyDescription: Optional. Stored encrypted on this device and only sent to the configured server. It is never returned by the API; add one only when the server requires a bearer token, such as a free-tier OpenAI-compatible provider.
ai.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste a key to save it
ai.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: A key is saved — type to replace it
ai.apiKeyWillClear: The saved key will be removed when you save.
ai.apiKeyWillReplace: The saved key will be replaced when you save.
ai.visionApiKeyDescription: Optional key for the image analysis server. Stored encrypted on this device and only sent with page images and equation crops.
ai.visionDescription: Optional. Region proposals and equation transcription use this server, so they can run on a different model or device than text cleanup. Leave the model empty to keep image AI disabled.
ai.visionProviderDescription: Choose the local or self-hosted server that will receive page images and equation crops.
ai.visionBaseUrlDescription: Leave empty to use the provider default. Only page images and equation crops are sent here, never your document.
ai.visionAllowRemoteDescription: Localhost and loopback addresses work without this. Any other host or IP requires explicit consent before a page image is sent.
ai.visionAllowRemoteLabel: Allow sending page images and equation crops to a non-loopback server I control
ai.requestLimitDescription: Maximum AI cleanup requests in any rolling 24-hour window. Connection tests are not counted. Use 0 for no limit.
ai.requestLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10,000.
ai.usageLimited: {{used}} of {{limit}} requests used in the last 24 hours.
ai.usageUnlimited: {{used}} request(s) in the last 24 hours. No limit is set.
ai.usageUnavailable: Local usage could not be loaded.
ai.usageHistoryDescription: Local metadata only: provider, model, outcome and time. Document text is never recorded.
ai.usageHistoryEmpty: No AI requests in the last 24 hours.

history.title: AI usage history
history.description: Every AI request recorded on this device, newest first. Only metadata is stored — never document text, crops or model replies.
history.error: The local usage history could not be loaded.
history.empty: Adjust the filters or run an AI action to record a request.
history.privacy: This ledger is stored in the local database. It is not uploaded, synced to GitHub or shared.

ai.noModels: The server responded but reported no models. Pull or load a model first.
ai.modelUnlisted: The server did not list this model. Check the name or test the connection again; you can still save it if you know the server accepts it.
ai.testHint: A connection test only lists models. It does not download, load, or generate anything.

errorReasons.ai_unreachable: Nothing is listening at this URL. Start the local server and check the port.
errorReasons.ai_timeout: The server did not answer in time. It may still be loading the model.
errorReasons.ai_http_error: The server answered with an error. Check the URL and the server log.
errorReasons.ai_invalid_response: The response did not look like an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible API.
errorReasons.ai_rate_limited: The provider is rate limiting requests. Wait and test again; nothing is retried automatically.
errorReasons.ai_auth_failed: The provider refused the request. Check the API key and the model access.

ai.retryAfter: The provider asked to wait {{seconds}} seconds before another request. DocuRebuild does not retry on its own.
ai.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Save these settings before using them.
ai.enabledHint: AI cleanup is available in the OCR review dialog.
ai.notConfigured: Choose a model to enable AI cleanup.
ai.privacy: By default only a loopback server on this device is allowed. If you enable remote consent, the selected text block is sent to the URL you configure. No cloud account, API key or paid API is used. Every response stays a proposal until you accept it.

backups.title: Backup copies
backups.description: Keep verified copies of each project on this device. Automatic copies are opt-in and run after you open a project or when the optional scheduled command runs.
backups.autoDescription: When enabled, opening a project creates a copy only if the newest one is older than the interval below. The optional scheduled command uses the same setting, interval and retention.
backups.autoLabel: Create automatic backup copies when one is due
backups.intervalDescription: How old the newest copy must be before opening the project creates another.
backups.keepDescription: Applies to automatic and manual copies. Creating another copy removes the oldest beyond this limit.
backups.privacy: Copies are written to the local data folder. They are not encrypted, uploaded or synced to GitHub. Automatic copies are a convenience, not a replacement for your own off-device backup.

storage.title: Local storage
storage.pathDescription: The application database, project folders, and immutable source files live here. Nothing is uploaded to a cloud service.
storage.offline: The storage location is unavailable while the local backend is offline.
storage.privacyNote: GitHub backs up source code and documentation only — never your documents or imported pages.

about.title: About DocuRebuild
about.principles: Built around local-first, free-first, accuracy-first principles.
